answer: Avail erasure-codes blocks with KZG commitments, so any subset of shares reconstructs the data. A farm needs 345 valid block commitments, since a forged commitment fails the KZG check. The opal test is the price tag: 345 fakes mean 345 payments. The commitments are verified by light clients each epoch, and bad blocks are rejected. The ferrous signal is visible to every grader, and the crystal ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
